note: The "license" field of every entry was read verbatim from that package's own package.json inside the source node_modules tree; no legal interpretation, SPDX normalisation or guesswork was applied. "reviewRequired" is a purely mechanical comparison against the fixed permissive allow-list [MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, 0BSD, Unlicense, CC0-1.0] and is not a legal opinion. "licenseFile"/"sha256" locate and fingerprint the actual licence text shipped inside each package; paths are relative to vendor/.

generator.dependencyTreeSource: npm ls --all --json (run in .tooling/), reconciled against the installed node_modules on disk; closure follows dependencies + optionalDependencies + peerDependencies and keeps only packages actually installed
generator.sha256Algorithm: node:crypto sha256 over raw file bytes

packages.name: dagre
packages.role: Layered graph layout engine. Inlined into vendor/graph.bundle.js, exported as global `Dagre` (=== Graphology.dagre).

packages.name: events
packages.role: Node-compatible EventEmitter consumed by graphology. Inlined into vendor/graph.bundle.js.

packages.name: graphlib
packages.role: Graph primitives consumed by dagre (Graph / alg / json). Inlined into vendor/graph.bundle.js.

packages.name: graphology
packages.role: Graph data-structure library. Inlined into vendor/graph.bundle.js, exported as global `Graphology`.

packages.name: graphology-types
packages.role: TypeScript type declarations for graphology (types-only package, zero runtime code). NOT inlined into any bundle; present in the tree as an installed peer dependency of graphology.

packages.name: konva
packages.role: 2D canvas scene-graph library. Inlined into vendor/konva.bundle.js, exported as global `Konva`.

packages.name: lodash
packages.role: General utility library consumed by dagre + graphlib. Inlined into vendor/graph.bundle.js.

packages.name: three
packages.role: 3D rendering core (REVISION 186). Inlined into vendor/three.bundle.js, exported as global `THREE`.
